title: The Bone Collector
author: Jeffery Deaver
summary: A forensic expert left paralysed after an accident is persuaded to help the police track a killer who leaves clues at each scene. A young patrol officer becomes his eyes and legs.
readIf: you like forensic thrillers with an inventive twist and a pair of strong, contrasting leads.
skipIf: you do not enjoy gruesome killings or a stack of cliffhanger chapters.

pairings.reason: The classic serial-killer thriller, with a more psychological and chilling flavour.
Another forensic-led story, centred on a medical examiner and the grim details of her work.
A bleak Scandinavian serial-killer story with a haunted, damaged detective.
